item.title: Lucky Charms Ice Cream
item.description: This Lucky Charms Ice Cream is packed with the nostalgic flavor of cereal and milk, with bits of crunchy marshmallows in every bite. The creamy base gets its authentic taste from an infusion of cereal-soaked dairy, blended until smooth for the perfect texture.

item.title: Guinness Chocolate Layer Cake with Chocolate Stout Syrup
item.description: Guinness chocolate layer cake with stout in the batter, chocolate stout syrup brushed over the layers, currants, currant jelly, and bittersweet chocolate icing.

item.title: Crispy Lemonade Chicken Drumsticks (Easy Oven Baked Recipe)
item.description: Crispy lemonade chicken drumsticks are marinated with lemon and buttermilk, coated in seasoned panko, and baked until golden with a crunchy crust.

item.title: Sticky Gochujang Steak Bites Over Rice
item.description: Gochujang steak bites seared in a skillet and coated in a sweet spicy Korean chili sauce. Serve over rice with sesame seeds and green onions.

item.title: Ham and Cheese Croissant Breakfast Bake
item.description: Buttery croissants layered with ham, Swiss & cheddar, & a rich egg custard baked until golden. An easy ham & cheese croissant breakfast bake perfect for brunch.

item.title: Bourbon Glazed Salmon
item.description: Bourbon glazed salmon with a sticky brown sugar glaze and crisp edges. Easy skillet dinner with a rich, savory finish.

item.title: Roasted Potatoes and Asparagus with Lemon and Garlic
item.description: Roasted potatoes and asparagus with lemon and garlic, cooked so everything finishes right. Golden potatoes and tender asparagus on one pan.

item.title: Strawberry Goat Cheese Salad with Maple Dijon Balsamic Vinaigrette
item.description: Strawberry goat cheese salad with spinach, avocado, pecans, and balsamic vinaigrette. Easy spring or summer salad. Serve as a side or light meal.

item.title: Blueberry Cheesecake Poke Cake
item.description: Blueberry cheesecake poke cake with creamy filling, real blueberry layers, and a soft vanilla base that soaks up every bit of flavor.

item.title: Ham and Cabbage Soup (Slow Cooker + Stovetop Option)
item.description: Ham & cabbage soup with potatoes, cabbage, & ham in a brothy pot. Slow cooker or stovetop, it cooks down into tender vegetables and a broth that lasts for days.
